subject: [PATCH 2/4] fuse: don't move pipe buffers into the page cache

reviews.author: Zi Yan
reviews.summary: Reviewer Zi Yan approved the patch and gave an Acked-by tag.
reviews.raw_body:
LGTM.

Acked-by: Zi Yan <ziy@nvidia.com>

Best Regards,
Yan, Zi

2026-11-10.patch_summary: This patch prevents the kernel from moving pipe buffers into the page cache when using splice() on a /dev/fuse device. The change ensures that data is always copied instead of moved, which was previously allowed as a hint but not guaranteed by the splice() function. This fix also prepares for the removal of ->try_steal() from pipe buffers and keeps FUSE_SPLICE_MOVE advertised to prevent libfuse from failing filesystem mounts.

reviews.author: Miklos Szeredi
reviews.summary: Reviewer noted that the FUSE_SPLICE_MOVE feature is not used by any major project, and thus requested Acked-by
reviews.raw_body:
Did some research and looks like this feature is not used by any major project.

Acked-by: Miklos Szeredi <mszeredi@redhat.com>

Thanks,
Miklos
